speaker: john_heminges
text: Seventeen shillings. I will say the figure once. Saturday's share, received.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seventeen. Write it received. I am not writing a total under it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No total. Last Saturday's fourteen stays last Saturday's. I am not adding a fortnight on the back of a share.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The seventeen can sit. I will not rest until I have seen what the goldsmith is building. Finish the book, and then I am for the river.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: The river, with him, once the share is truly said. I am not going down to look at a rumour and a balance in the same hour.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The afternoon was the old play, and you were in it. The share is not a wage for naming the man. Leave him as the afternoon left him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In it, and unnamed here. I am not improving the bill after the doors have shut.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then the next week, John, before James spends the saying of seventeen on a boat. Read what was set.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Monday, Two Gentlemen of Verona, and you play. Tuesday, rehearsal at nine, and Love's Labour's Lost at two, and you play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Wednesday, Two Gentlemen again, and you play. Friday, Love's Labour's Lost, and you play. Saturday the twenty-sixth, Errors, and you play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Those are the days. I am not adding a Thursday the book has not set.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Thursday is not on this cloth. I will not invent an empty afternoon to make the week look even.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Even is not my errand. The goldsmith's timber is. Davy's boat, from the Old Swan. No landing on that bank.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: No landing. Looking is the bargain. The five pound was said on Thursday. It is not coming out of this seventeen.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Not out of this seventeen. Five shillings a week, five pound for the month, stands where you said pay it. This cloth is the share.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then do not say the share again unless someone failed to hear it. I heard seventeen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Received. No total. Monday and Wednesday, Two Gentlemen, and I play. Tuesday and Friday, Love's Labour's Lost, and I play. Saturday, Errors, and I play.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Rehearsal Tuesday at nine. It is on the sheet beside the play. I heard myself say it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Seventeen, received, and a Thursday not written. I can remember two facts if they stay two facts.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Then remember them on the way to the stair. I am not waiting on a second count.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: One count. I am coming to look, and I am not coming to land.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not since May, for me. I am coming. The seventeen stays received. It does not need to be said in the boat.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Said here. I am not walking it down to the water to be counted a second time.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go and look. The old play is done. The heat can have whatever speech is left.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Done. Seventeen shillings, the dates, and no sum underneath.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The stair. I have waited since the doors opened, and I am finished with waiting.
